user_symptom: My insurer has not settled my motor claim on time.
first_action: Raise the complaint with the insurer’s grievance officer first and capture claim number, accident date and pending document list.
ombudsman_rule: If insurer does not respond within 15 days, escalate to IRDAI; Ombudsman is available after rejection / non-resolution / 30 days non-response subject to personal-lines conditions.
required_evidence: Claim form, policy copy, claim intimation proof, repair estimate
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Claim form, policy copy, claim intimation proof, repair estimate.

user_symptom: Only part of my repair bill was approved.
first_action: Ask for the insurer’s written break-up showing depreciation, deductibles, exclusions and non-payable items.
ombudsman_rule: Premium disputes, partial repudiation and policy interpretation are Ombudsman-covered grounds for eligible individual policies.
required_evidence: Settlement letter, surveyor report, invoice, policy schedule
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Settlement letter, surveyor report, invoice, policy schedule.

user_symptom: My own-damage or health claim was fully rejected.
first_action: Request a written repudiation letter citing policy clause, exclusion and factual basis.
ombudsman_rule: Total repudiation is an Ombudsman ground for eligible individual policies up to the monetary cap.
required_evidence: Repudiation letter, proposal form, policy wording, evidence of loss
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Repudiation letter, proposal form, policy wording, evidence of loss.

user_symptom: The insurer says I owe more premium / renewal premium changed unexpectedly.
first_action: Ask for premium calculation, endorsement trail and whether claim history or slab changes affected pricing.
ombudsman_rule: Disputes on premium paid or payable can go to the Ombudsman for eligible personal policies.
required_evidence: Receipt, schedule, endorsement copies, renewal quote comparison
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Receipt, schedule, endorsement copies, renewal quote comparison.

user_symptom: The policy sold to me is not what the seller explained.
first_action: Capture seller channel, sales script, brochure, proposal form and the mismatch between promised and issued coverage.
ombudsman_rule: Misrepresentation of policy terms is an Ombudsman ground; flag possible mis-selling.
required_evidence: Proposal form, brochure, welcome kit, call/chat transcript
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Proposal form, brochure, welcome kit, call/chat transcript.

user_symptom: My issued policy does not match the proposal I signed.
first_action: Compare issued schedule against proposal form field by field; note sum insured, add-ons, IDV and nominee details.
ombudsman_rule: Issuance not in conformity with proposal form is an Ombudsman ground.
required_evidence: Proposal form, policy schedule, payment proof
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Proposal form, policy schedule, payment proof.

user_symptom: Premium was collected but the policy was not issued.
first_action: Ask for payment reference, insurer acknowledgement and risk commencement status.
ombudsman_rule: Non-issuance after receipt of premium can go to the Ombudsman for eligible cases.
required_evidence: Payment proof, proposal number, email/SMS acknowledgements
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Payment proof, proposal number, email/SMS acknowledgements.

user_symptom: Endorsement / address change / NCB update is stuck.
first_action: Log a service ticket with insurer and retain timestamped proof of request.
ombudsman_rule: Policy-servicing grievances against insurer, agents or intermediaries are Ombudsman grounds if personal-lines conditions are met.
required_evidence: Ticket number, policy copy, endorsement request
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Ticket number, policy copy, endorsement request.

user_symptom: I received suspicious calls claiming to be from IRDAI / insurer.
first_action: Do not pay; record number, message content and report to insurer plus regulator complaint channels.
ombudsman_rule: Treat as fraud / unfair business practice rather than coverage dispute.
required_evidence: Call log, screenshots, payment request proof
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 0 days, move to Insurer + regulator awareness/reporting channel. Keep all proofs ready: Call log, screenshots, payment request proof.

user_symptom: I was pushed into an unsuitable product.
first_action: Document why the product was unsuitable relative to your age, use case, budget and disclosure received.
ombudsman_rule: May be framed as misrepresentation / policy mismatch / unfair business practice depending facts.
required_evidence: Suitability mismatch note, policy doc, sales proof
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Suitability mismatch note, policy doc, sales proof.

user_symptom: Claim was rejected only because I informed late.
first_action: Ask insurer to justify why delay caused prejudice; collect evidence of unavoidable circumstances.
ombudsman_rule: IRDAI has advised insurers not to reject genuine claims merely for delay without valid grounds.
required_evidence: Repudiation letter, accident timeline, hospital/police/garage records
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Repudiation letter, accident timeline, hospital/police/garage records.

user_symptom: I never received the e-policy / Customer Information Sheet.
first_action: Request re-issuance of e-policy, CIS and proof of delivery, then log grievance if ignored.
ombudsman_rule: Use the current policyholder protection framework and CIS requirement to support the complaint.
required_evidence: Proposal reference, policy schedule, email trail
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: Proposal reference, policy schedule, email trail.

user_symptom: A refund / claim amount is missing or marked unclaimed.
first_action: Check insurer’s searchable unclaimed amount database and verify nominee / bank-account details.
ombudsman_rule: Use unclaimed amount disclosure and payout rules under policyholder protection / operations circulars.
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 15 days, move to IRDAI/Bima Bharosa. Keep all proofs ready: PAN/KYC, bank details, policy/claim reference.

user_symptom: I need to know whether a vehicle is insured.
first_action: Use a vehicle-status lookup tool / IIB-linked service to fetch insurer and policy office details when available.
ombudsman_rule: This is an information retrieval flow, not a grievance flow.
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 0 days, move to Information support. Keep all proofs ready: Vehicle registration number.

user_symptom: I filed a complaint; how do I track it?
first_action: Track status through the insurer system and the regulator’s online portal; note ageing and pending actions.
ombudsman_rule: Use structured ticket IDs and ageing logic to guide the customer.
required_evidence: Complaint number, insurer ticket, policy number
plain_language_script: Start with the insurer. If they do not resolve the issue within 0 days, move to Bima Bharosa / IGMS lineage. Keep all proofs ready: Complaint number, insurer ticket, policy number.
